named_subject: a miner's safety lamp, drawn as the doodle's domed cylinder with vertical bars
evidence: e.png 1-8 against f.png 1-8: both move the lamp from the upper left rightward and straighten its tilt over the same span, with the drawing advancing a few pixels per frame and no gaps (g.png path 1 to 7 is a continuous rightward drift). e.png 9-20 hold upright at the same spot while f.png 9-20 also hold. e.png 21-25 the drawing grows slightly and rises, matching f.png 21-25 where the regrip brings the lamp closer; e.png 25-32 then holds at the larger size as f.png 25-32 holds. g.png shows a single tight cluster after frame 7 with no reversals. The construction of c.png (dome, slanted band, crossbar with left tick, three vertical strokes of unequal length, open bottom-left corner of the body outline) is kept in every frame. Only still frames were examined, not playback.
primary_gap: The crossbar and its left tick change line weight from frame to frame (heavy in e.png 1, 9-11, 17-24; thin in 2-8, 12-16, 25-32), which will read as flicker of that stroke in playback while the rest of the drawing holds steady.
closes_when: The crossbar stroke keeps one constant thickness and the left tick keeps one constant length in all 32 frames of e.png.
protect: The c.png construction and stroke habits (wobbly dome, slanted band, crossbar overshooting left with a short drop tick, three uneven vertical strokes, tapered body); the film-matched path: left-tilted start, rightward slide and straightening over frames 1-8, hold from 9, slight growth and rise around 21-25 then hold; the stable size within each hold.
identity_gap: The character is the c.png drawing throughout; only the varying weight of the crossbar stroke departs from the doodle's single consistent pen weight.
